SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW t AS SELECT 1
READ	SELECT 1 + '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1 - '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1 * '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 4 / '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 + '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 - '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 * '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 4.4 / '2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 + '2.2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 - '2.2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 1.1 * '2.2' FROM t
READ	SELECT 4.4 / '2.2' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || cast(1 as smallint) || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || 1 || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || cast(1 as bigint) || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || cast(1.1 as float) || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || cast(1.1 as double) || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || 1.1 || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || cast(1.1 as decimal(8,3)) || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || 'abcd' || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || date('1996-09-09') || '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT '$' || timestamp('1996-09-09 10:11:12.4' )|| '$' FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1 as smallint)) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1 as int)) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1 as bigint)) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1.1 as float)) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1.1 as double)) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(1.1) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(cast(1.1 as decimal(8,3))) FROM t
READ	SELECT length('four') FROM t
READ	SELECT length(date('1996-09-10')) FROM t
READ	SELECT length(timestamp('1996-09-10 10:11:12.4')) FROM t
READ	SELECT '12:00:00' = TIME'12:00:00' FROM t
READ	SELECT '12:00:01' > TIME'12:00:00' FROM t
READ	SELECT time_trunc('HOUR', '12:34:56') FROM t
READ	SELECT year( '1996-01-10') FROM t
READ	SELECT month( '1996-01-10') FROM t
READ	SELECT day( '1996-01-10') FROM t
READ	SELECT hour( '10:11:12') FROM t
READ	SELECT minute( '10:11:12') FROM t
READ	SELECT second( '10:11:12') FROM t
READ	select 1 like '%' FROM t
READ	select date('1996-09-10') like '19%' FROM t
READ	select '1' like 1 FROM t
READ	select '1 ' like 1 FROM t
READ	select '1996-09-10' like date('1996-09-10') FROM t
